goal: Implement lesson publishing: transactional publish of lessons.draft_json into immutable lesson_versions snapshot (version_no increment, current_version_id, PUBLISHED status, published_at/by), admin version read APIs, learner-safe projection stripping DraftSchema.LEARNER_HIDDEN_KEYS, public learner read APIs for published lessons + snapshots, and admin POST /admin/lessons/{id}/preview reusing the same projection over the draft without publishing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v1/admin/lessons/{id}/publish runs PUBLISH-level DraftValidator; on any error returns 422 with field-level errors, creates nothing. On success inserts lesson_versions (version_no = max+1 for the lesson), sets lessons.current_version_id, status=PUBLISHED, published_at, published_by in ONE transaction.

Publish eligibility: lesson must not be ARCHIVED; event must be PUBLISHED; template must exist, be enabled, and schema_version must match draft schemaVersion. Violations -> 409/422 with existing error codes.
Version concurrency: two simultaneous publishes cannot produce the same version_no (unique (lesson_id,version_no) + serialization or retry). No partial version on failure.
Admin version APIs: list versions of a lesson, get specific version, get current version — all CONTENT_ADMIN, standard envelope.

Snapshot contract: snapshot_json contains lessonId, title, centralQuestion, objectives, templateCode, schemaVersion, ordered stages/activities with config+validation+feedback, nextStageIds transitions, completion config, and evidence/asset references resolvable at render time.

Learner-safe projection: a projection layer produces a presentation DTO that omits DraftSchema.LEARNER_HIDDEN_KEYS (correctOptionIds, correctPairs, correctOrder, expectedOrder, answerKey...) and validation internals; unit/IT proves no answer key leaks.

Learner APIs: list published lessons of a published event, get published lesson metadata, get current version learner-safe content. Unauthenticated or unpublished -> 404/401 per envelope; no admin/draft content exposed.
POST /api/v1/admin/lessons/{id}/preview returns the same learner-safe projection over the CURRENT draft without writing any lesson_versions row or changing status; supports incomplete drafts.

Republish: editing the draft after publish then publishing again creates version_no+1, leaves prior version immutable (trigger), and does not touch existing learner attempts' pinned version (no UPDATE on learner_attempts).
Auth: publish/preview/version APIs CONTENT_ADMIN only (anon 401, LEARNER 403); learner APIs are authenticated-learner accessible; public GET /events* unchanged.

Tests + regression: ITs for publish/republish/versions/preview/learner reads incl. concurrency + immutability + no-answer-key-leak; existing TASK-0008/0009 ITs stay green; mvnw verify exit 0; docs updated.

nextAction: Implementation + code-reviewer fixes done; mvnw verify green (63 unit + 111 IT = 174 tests, 0 failures). Awaiting user authorization to push; mark done after commit.
